title: Understanding Residuals
text: Residuals are the differences between the observed values and the predicted values from a model. In a well-fitted model, residuals should be randomly scattered around zero.

title: Pattern in Residuals
text: Look for patterns in the residual plot. If residuals show a systematic pattern, it might indicate a problem with the model, such as a missing variable or incorrect functional form.

title: Interpreting the Residual Plot
text: What does it mean if the residuals are mostly above zero?
choices: The design matrix is not full column rank.
One or more of the columns used to predict $$y$$ must undergo a log transformation.
The model does not include an intercept term.
